## DotNetBrowser

Current version: 4.3.3. Chromium build: 155.0.8059.40. Release date: 2026-10-08.

- [DotNetBrowser | .NET web browser for WPF, Avalonia UI, and WinForms apps](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/): Add Chromium web browser to your .NET app. Display modern web pages in WPF,  Avalonia UI, WinUI 3, and WinForms. Work with DOM, JS, network, printing, etc.

### Releases

- [DotNetBrowser 4.3.3](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-3-3/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.3.3 - Chromium 155 with screen capture fixes.
- [DotNetBrowser 4.3.2](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-3-2/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.3.2 - Memory management and stability fixes.
- [DotNetBrowser 4.3.1](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-3-1/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.3.1 - Chromium 153 with rendering and stability fixes.
- [DotNetBrowser 4.3.0](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-3-0/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.3.0 - Default fonts configuration and Chromium 152 update.
- [DotNetBrowser 4.2.3](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-2-3/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.2.3 - Chromium 151.0.7922.138 and quality improvements.
- [DotNetBrowser 4.2.2](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-2-2/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.2.2 - External app link handling, macOS 12 deprecation, Chromium 151.0.7922.72, and quality enhancements.
- [DotNetBrowser 4.2.1](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-2-1/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.2.1 - Chromium 150.0.7871.125 and quality improvements.
- [DotNetBrowser 4.2.0](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-2-0/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.2.0 - Touch ID on macOS and Chromium 150 security update
- [DotNetBrowser 4.1.1](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-1-1/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.1.1 - Chromium 149 security update, password store API changes, and UrlRequestJob improvements
- [DotNetBrowser 4.1.0](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-1-0/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.1.0 - API changes, per-browser zoom mode, Avalonia 12 support and Chromium 148.
- [DotNetBrowser 4.0.1](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-0-1/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.0.1 - Chromium 147.0.7727.138 security update and crash fixes for macOS.
- [DotNetBrowser 4.0.0](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/2026/v4-0-0/index.md): DotNetBrowser 4.0.0 - support trimming and AOT, per-browser rendering modes, Chromium 147
- [Release Policy](https://teamdev.com/dotnetbrowser/releases/index.md): This section contains a complete release history for DotNetBrowser in reverse chronological order.
